Electricity, diesel, final energy and CO: Wutar lantarki, dizal, makamashin ƙarshe da CO2e a shekara ga kowace layi, kowane nau'in sufuri da hanyar sadarwa baki ɗaya, tare da ƙarfi ga kowace km ta abin hawa da kowace km ta wurin zama.
Traction energy and greenhouse gas emiss: Makamashin jan abin hawa da hayaƙin iskar gas mai ɗumama duniya na kowace layi a shekara, ga kowane nau'in sufuri da hanyar sadarwa, daga km na abin hawa da kowace layi ke yi: wutar lantarki a tashar wuta ko caja, dizal a lita, da CO2e daga ƙarfin hayaƙin layin wutar lantarki da dizal daga rijiya zuwa ƙafa. Ana nuna shi a shafin Teburori.
